model_metadata.fit_data: TRAIN only; student and evaluator not read by this stage

scale_evidence.reuse_rationale: Geometry-only sigma/beta come from TRAIN reference residuals and transition spans and do not depend on the emission classifier family, so the historical immutable fit is reused read-only instead of recomputed.

freeze.selection_boundary_note: Historical geometry-only, phase-three trio and earlier HistGB student results were available as context; this predeclared search reads only TRAIN predictions/references and never reads student scores. Final student ablation starts only after this freeze.
freeze.historical_note: Historical decoder freezes at artifacts/match_config.json (reports/decoder/freeze.json, earlier HistGB) and artifacts/phase_three/match_config.json (reports/phase_three/decoder/freeze.json, requested trio) are preserved read-only; neither is this phase's final result.
freeze.objective: mean exact-original-ID length-weighted repeated-arc route F1 across the eight TRAIN calibration trips; a failed trip contributes zero
